$comment: The destinations the fixture provider knows about.
This is the one file in data/ whose contents are true: the opening-hours
advice, the markets, the day trips. It is here rather than in TypeScript so
that both runtimes read the same rows, and so that adding a city is a data
change a person can make without touching an agent loop.
`aliases` is how free text resolves. It used to be a separate map, and a
destination could end up in one and not the other; a city that cannot be
named is a city that does not exist, so the names live on the record.
